about: What the user has approved fetching. Fetchers read this file (cosh/approved.py) and refuse anything outside it, so a plain rerun can't exceed an approval. Widen a range only after the user approves, in the same commit as a line in docs/plan.md's decisions log. CLAUDE.md keeps the reasons and the load rules.
